name: Nightstalker Form
body:
School transmutation; Level beguiler 5, bard 5, inquisitor 5, lathspell 4, legendary ninja 4, ranger 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (bottled air from the shadow plane)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Your form twists and splits into hideous shadow. When you cast this spell you inhale the bottled air and transform into a shadowy version of yourself. You gain darkvision 60 ft (or your existing darkvision increases by 60 ft), a +4 enhancement bonus to Dexterity, a +3 luck bonus on attack rolls, a +3 deflection bonus to armor class, and a +5 bonus to Perception and Stealth skill checks. In addition you deal an extra 2d6 damage to creatures you flank or are denied their Dexterity bonus to armor class, this stacks with sneak attack and similar abilities. You may end this spell early as a swift action, becoming incorporeal and gaining a 60 ft fly speed until the end of your turn. However you can only move until the beginning of your next turn.
